blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The slow pace of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial once the defense started presenting witnesses — and their request to defer trial dates — only validates the need to expedite the proceedings and withdraw several articles, Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro said on Friday. In a press briefing after Day 45 of Duterte’s trial, Luistro said that with the way the defense is dragging the trial, they would have consumed more time if three of four Articles of Impeachment were not withdrawn by the prosecution.
